title: Xingyu Qian · Academic
description: I am a PhD student at the Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China, since September 2025, advised by Wenbing Huang. I studied Artificial Intelligence at the School of Automation, Central South University, from September 2021 to June 2025, and received the National Scholarship in 2022 and 2024. From February 2025 to September 2026, I interned as an Algorithm Engineer working on Agentic AI at DAMO Academy, Alibaba Group, mentored by Yu Rong and Tingyang Xu.
